P.name: Sovereign's Domination
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Viego''' scores an enemy champion {{tip|takedown}} while alive and within 3 seconds of damaging them, a ''Mist Wraith'' spawns from that champion's corpse for 8 seconds. '''Viego''' can basic attack a ''Mist Wraith'' to consume it: causing him to {{tip|blink}} to its location after winding up for 1 second, during which he is {{tip|untargetable}} (except to {{tip|turrets}}) and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}. He then gains ''Possession'' and {{tip|heals}} himself for {{as|2%|health}} {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.4}}% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}} {{as|(+ 5% per 100% '''bonus''' attack speed)}} {{as|of the target's '''maximum''' health}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Possession:}} For 10 seconds, '''Viego''' assumes the enemy champion's form and gains their {{tip|basic attacks}}, {{tip|abilities|basic abilities}}, [[item]]s (excluding [[trinket item]]s), and base [[champion statistic|stats]] (based on '''Viego's''' [[Experience (champion)|level]]). He also gains a free cast of ''{{ai|Heartbreaker|Viego}}'', which is initially placed on a {{sti|cd|{{fd|1.5}}-second}} cooldown, and {{sti|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing enemy champions within 2500 units.
P.description3: '''Viego''' cannot use the possessed champion's [[Active ability items|item actives]] or [[consumable item]]s, and is unable to use the [[shop]] during ''Possession''. Casting ''{{ai|Heartbreaker|Viego}}'' or attacking a ''Mist Wraith'' ends ''Possession'' immediately.
P.description4: '''''Viego''' will preserve his {{as|'''current''' health percentage}} between transformations.''

Q.name: Blade of the Ruined King
Q.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Viego's''' basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}. This damage can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|170|50}}|critical damage}} damage, has a minimum threshold and is capped at 80 against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|2 to 6}}% of target's '''current''' health}}|Critical Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|2*1.7 to 6*1.7}}% of target's '''current''' health}}}}
{{st|Minimum Bonus Damage|{{ap|10 to 30}}}}
Q.description2: Additionally, his damaging {{tip|abilities}} apply a mark to enemies hit for 4 seconds. '''Viego's''' next basic attack against a marked target is empowered to consume the mark {{tip|on-hit}} to strike a second time, dealing {{tt|{{as|20% AD}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}}|Scales on current AD and AP}} {{as|physical damage}}. He also {{tip|heal|heals}} himself for a portion of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt by the second strike: 100% against {{tip|minions}}, 125% against monsters, and 150% against other targets.
Q.description3: The second strike applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects and can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Viego|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage.
Q.description4: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viego''' stabs in a line in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 60|critScaling=true}}.
Q.description5: ''Blade of the Ruined King's passive remains under {{ai|Sovereign's Domination|Viego|Possession}}, and while transformed, the second strike is instead converted to '''bonus''' damage on-hit which no longer applies on-hit effects but can still {{tip|critically strike}} (based on the Possession's stats, abilities and/or item effects).''
Q.cast time: {{as|{{ap|1.4*100}}% of '''Viego's''' windup time|as}} ({{ap|1.4*(1/{{ccd|Viego|as_base}})*{{ccd|Viego|windup}}|round=3}} at {{as|'''base''' attack speed}})

W.name: Spectral Maw
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viego''' {{tip|channel|charges}} while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 10% for up to 3 seconds to increase ''Spectral Maw's'' missile range and {{tip|stun}} duration over the first second of the channel.
W.description2: ''Spectral Maw'' can be recast within the duration. If the charge completes without reactivation, ''Spectral Maw'' is cancelled and placed on {{sti|full cooldown}}. If the charge is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}, it will be placed on a 3-second cooldown.
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Viego''' hurls a blast of mist in the target direction and {{tip|dash|dashes}} a fixed distance in the same direction, though not through terrain. The mist deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|stuns}} them for {{pp|type=channel time|0.25 to 1.25 for 5|0 to 1|formula=0.25 + (0.25 per 0.25 seconds channeled).|changedisplay = true}} seconds.
W.description4: ''Spectral Maw {{tip|Basic attack reset|resets}} '''Viego's''' basic attack timer. '''Viego''' can cast any of his abilities during the dash.''

E.name: Harrowed Path
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viego''' sends a spectre in the target direction that creates a trail of mist in its wake which lasts 8 seconds. If it hits [[terrain]], the mist will spread further around either side.
E.description2: While inside the mist, '''Viego''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}. If he does not attack or cast abilities, he also gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and {{tip|camouflage}}.
E.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|30 to 50}}%}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|25 to 35}}% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 AP)}}}}
E.description3: Declaring a basic attack or casting an ability will break the camouflage and remove the {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}, preventing '''Viego''' from gaining them again for 1 second, increased to 2 seconds if he attacked a large {{tip|monster}}. This duration refreshes on subsequent attacks and ability casts.
E.description4: ''Harrowed Path can be cast during any of '''Viego's''' abilities. '''Viego''' cannot gain the camouflage nor {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} from Harrowed Path for 1 second if he casts it during {{ais|Spectral Maw|Viego}} channel or starts the channel while the mist was active.''

R.name: Heartbreaker
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viego''' gains {{tip|displacement immunity}} over the cast time, then {{tip|blink|blinks}} to the target location. Upon arrival, he strikes the {{tt|most wounded|Lowest health percent}} enemy champion {{tt|nearby|Alternatively the closest one if all targets have the same percent health}}, dealing {{as|physical damage}}, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 99% for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects. Other nearby enemies are {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} up to 400-units away based on proximity, though not through terrain.
R.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|12 to 20}}% {{as|(+ 5% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''missing''' health}}}}
R.description2: All targets hit are dealt {{as|120% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 70|critScaling=true}}.
R.description3: ''If a {{ai|Sovereign's Domination|Viego|Possession}} is discarded, Heartbreaker will be placed on a {{sti|cd|{{fd|1.5}}-second}} cooldown if it is not already on cooldown.''
